question: Does the existing E8 boundary plus massive complement contain the light graded fields required for a source-derived flavor mass map, and what exact locality information is lost by projection?
summary_de: Das volle Quellgitter verklebt D8 und die neutrale n/z-Ebene in vier Klassen. Das Komplement kompensiert die halbe Monodromie zwischen fermionischem Vektor und bosonischem Spinorstrom. Die gapped E8-Phase traegt trotzdem keinen leichten lokalen odd Sektor; paritaetserhaltende Schur-Elimination erzeugt ihn nicht. Alle anderen primitiven q/Y-neutralen Nullterme haben fuer jeden getrennten Paarboost Skalendimension mindestens8; mit Glue ist z der einzige Norm8-Konkurrent. Ein gewaehlter Mischpunkt erlaubt den bekannten neutralen Ising-Mechanismus, aber weder Kopplungsgleichheit noch Domains oder3+1D-Fermionen folgen aus der Quelle.
kills: Identify pure E8 current states as the light odd Yukawa legs while keeping the auxiliary Dirac sector massive, then generate those missing legs by Schur elimination.
Drop the neutral complement and simultaneously retain the D8 vector and spinor projections as mutually local ordinary vertex fields.
Make a competing primitive q/Y-neutral self-null cosine relevant by only changing the existing separated pair-boost metric.
Use an integral isometry of the original microscopic vertex lattice exchanging n and z to force equality of their couplings.
assumptions: The existing conditional I_(9,1) local boundary lattice, source number q, hypercharge Y and oriented glue
Inherited microscopic fermion parity, cocycles and compatible spin structure
Existing exact E8 plus massive Dirac factorization only for the explicit low odd threshold
E8/pair block separation and declared Gaussian boost family only for the universal relevance bound
Chosen positive mixed energy and two specified cosine couplings only for the standard continuum Ising diagnostic
leaves_open: P1/P2 origin of channel multiplicity, full positive energy, interactions and physical state/phase
Native light odd fields with the actual Spin10/Standard Model representations
Source-derived nonzero flavor mixing operators and full complex functional
Dynamical domain formation or physical selection of criticality
Common local chiral3+1D continuum and gravity
not_claimed: A no-go for fermionic fields in other phases or for nonlocal/twist sector realizations
Universal stability under arbitrary infinite-volume interactions
A full microscopic spectrum or QWZ scaling theorem at the proposed Ising point
A locality monodromy as a physical CP phase
Any complete TFPT or physical-gate closure
